topic: 2026 Host Government Agreement (HGA) and FID timeline
wiki_text: In early 2026 the Tanzania LNG project (Lindi/Likong'o; Equinor, Shell, ExxonMobil, Medco Energi, Pavilion Energy and state-owned TPDC) moved into the final stage of its legal framework. Tanzanian officials (Minister of State for Planning and Investment Kitila Mkumbo) said commercial negotiations were complete and the Host Government Agreement was expected to be signed before June 2026; in April 2026 Prime Minister Mwigulu Nchemba told Parliament the ~US$42bn project was 'on track' with talks at an advanced stage. Outstanding negotiation points reported included a Tanzanian request that at least ~3% of extracted gas be reserved for domestic use and expanded local-content participation. Signing the HGA triggers FEED (typically 2-3 years), positioning a realistic Final Investment Decision around 2028-2029, with first LNG cargoes projected for the early 2030s (~2034). As of the dates checked (Jan-Apr 2026) the HGA had not yet been signed; the project therefore remained pre-FID.
